description.value: Matcha Cafe Maiko is a specialty matcha cafe chain originating from Hawaii, known for its premium matcha soft serve and drinks made with stone-ground Kyoto matcha. This Richmond location is situated in the Saba Road commercial area, convenient for cyclists on the flat, bike-friendly roads of central Richmond.
